records.title: XRP exchange balances — same-wallet changes, SBI VC Trade and wrapped-reserve exclusions
records.summary: As of 2026-10-30 08:00 UTC, XRP Insights reports 22.37B XRP in 701 XRPL wallets publicly attributed to 24 exchanges. Same-wallet net change is -234.9M over Oct23-Oct30 and -146.1M over Sep30-Oct30. Binance is 2.58B across 153 wallets, with -173.2M 7d and -164.5M 30d; Coinbase is 5.84B across 358 wallets, with +1.1M 7d and +12.5M 30d. SBI VC Trade is 59.5M across two wallets, cold-labeled >99%, with -893K 7d and -10.5M 30d. Regional tracked balances: South Korea 8.60B (38.4%), United States 8.59B (38.4%), Japan 1.38B (6.2%). 488.4M XRP is identified as non-customer reserve/fund balances: 325.8M Binance-Peg backing, 151.4M cbXRP backing and 11.2M insurance/charity.
records.methodology: Balances are read directly from XRPL via rippled account_info once daily around 08:00 UTC; exchange attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels; same-wallet changes compare only wallets present at both endpoints. Page refreshes hourly, balances update daily.
records.limitations: Public wallet labels, not official exchange PoR or beneficial-owner identification. Includes cold custody and wrapped-token backing reserves; not tradable float. No per-wallet history is published, so same-wallet net changes cannot identify customer withdrawals, theft, internal migration or sales. Coverage gaps and label additions can distort naive totals. SBI VC Trade 59.5M is exchange-attributed custody, not proven SBI Group proprietary holdings.
